description: KL-15 is a specialized Regional Transport Office code in Kerala dedicated to the Nationalised Sector, specifically for the Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC). It manages the registration and regulation of the state-run bus fleet across the entire state of Kerala. The office is centrally located at the KSRTC headquarters in the state capital.
address: Transport Bhavan, Near Attukal Shopping Complex, East Fort, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala
jurisdictionAreas: Kerala State Road Transport Corporation Depots
